二维笛卡尔矩阵例。3/5–4/5矩阵是一般正交旋转教学例，不据此假设有限阶，也不: A two-dimensional Cartesian matrix example. The 3/5–4/5 matrix illustrates a general orthogonal rotation; no finite order or compatibility with a periodic crystal is assumed. The shear tests general algebra and is not a rigid rotation. For a 90° rotation, −R=R⁻¹ happens to hold, so the 3/5,4/5 rotation distinguishes negation from inversion.
